notes: Read all 64 line-numbered source lines before editing; every line was considered. L1 `import { useState, useMemo } from 'react'` -> ported verbatim (RN-compatible). L2 `import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next'` -> native-safe `useNativeTranslationFallback` returning t(key, fallback?) => fallback ?? key (the sibling ClientUtilitiesSection precedent), keeping every key. L3 `import { Network } from 'lucide-react'` -> decorative NETWORK_GLYPH '\u29BF' AppText (same glyph the sibling port uses for Network), reused for the ToolCard chip + the search input leading icon.

L4 `import { Input, Badge, DataTable, type Column } from '@/components/ui'` -> none have a native parity port, so minimal native-safe equivalents are reproduced locally (the established reproduce-locally precedent): `SearchInput` (RN TextInput + leading icon, replaces Input), `StatusBadge` (chip View+AppText, replaces Badge size='sm'), `NativeDataTable<T>` (replaces DataTable), and the `Column<T>` shape {key, header, render, sortable} ported verbatim. L5 `import { ToolCard } from '../ToolCard'` -> reproduced locally as `ToolCard` (GlassPanel header chip + title/description + children) since no native ToolCard parity port exists. L6 `import { HTTP_CODES } from '../constants'` -> ported verbatim as a local 19-entry HTTP_CODES constant (plain data, no browser dependency).

L8-10 `export function HttpStatusTool()` + `const { t } = useTranslation()` + `const [search, setSearch] = useState('')` -> ported verbatim (component exported as named HttpStatusTool; t from the native fallback; identical `search` state name).

L12-21 `filtered` useMemo ported 1:1: empty-search returns HTTP_CODES, else lowercases the query and filters by String(c.code).includes(q) || c.text.toLowerCase().includes(q) || c.desc.toLowerCase().includes(q), dep [search] preserved.

L23-42 `columns` useMemo (Column<{code,text,desc}>[]) ported 1:1 with dep [t]. L25-37 code column {key:'code', header:t('Status Code'), sortable:true, render -> StatusBadge} preserves the exact range->variant map r.code<300?'success':<400?'info':<500?'warning':'danger' and renders {r.code}. L38 text column {key:'text', header:t('Status Text'), render -> AppText styles.statusText} maps the web span (text-sm font-medium text-white) to fontSize 14 / fontWeight 500 / colors.textPrimary. L39 desc column {key:'desc', header:t('Status Desc'), render -> AppText tone='secondary' styles.statusDesc} maps the web span (text-xs text-[var(--text-secondary)]) to typography.caption / colors.textSecondary.

Badge variant->native colour mapping: success->success(green) tokens, info->accent(cyan) tokens (the established cyan 'informational' analog, since native tokens have no separate blue), warning->warning(amber) tokens, danger->danger(rose) tokens; chip uses rounded-full (borderRadius 999), text-xs (typography.caption), font-medium (fontWeight 500), matching Badge size='sm'.

L44-62 the render tree ported 1:1. L45 `<ToolCard icon={Network} color='amber' title={t('Http Status')} description={t('Http Status Desc')}>` -> local ToolCard with glyph={NETWORK_GLYPH} color='amber' (CHIP_COLORS amber->warning tokens, mirroring constants ICON_COLOR_MAP bg/10 text ring/20) title/description preserved. L46 `<div className='space-y-3'>` -> View styles.body (gap spacing.md=12). L47-52 `<Input placeholder={t('Search Codes')} value={search} onChange={e=>setSearch(e.target.value)} icon={<Network/>} />` -> SearchInput (onChangeText={setSearch} replaces the e.target.value handler, glyph leading icon, testID http-status-search). L53-60 `<DataTable tableId='admin:http-status-codes' columns data={filtered} keyExtractor={r=>r.code} compact pagination />` -> NativeDataTable with tableId 'http-status-table', columns, data={filtered}, keyExtractor r=>r.code, compact, pagination. L63-64 closing tags + export preserved.

Controlled-sort parity: the web DataTable sort is caller-controlled and HttpStatusTool passes NO sortKey/sortDir/onSort, so the sortable:true code column shows a sort indicator but tapping is a no-op and rows render in `filtered` order. The native port mirrors this exactly: a static '\u2195' sort glyph on the sortable header, rows rendered in `filtered` order, no tap handler. Pagination uses the web default page size 25 (DataTable L356), so all 19 codes fit one page and no pager shows; the clamp + Prev/Next pager is implemented faithfully so a longer data set paginates. The web DataTable default emptyMessage 'No data' (DataTable L285) is reproduced for the no-match state (testID http-status-table-empty).

No DOM-only modules, browser HTML (div/span), window/document, react-i18next, lucide-react, Recharts, Leaflet, @/lib/cn, or old web @/components/ui imports are present in the native output — only React (useMemo/useState), react-native primitives (Pressable/StyleSheet/TextInput/View), the native AppText + GlassPanel, and the theme tokens (colors/spacing/typography). A focused __tests__/HttpStatusTool.test.tsx exercises: the ToolCard title/description, all 19 rows rendered, the case-insensitive code|text|desc filter (e.g. '404' -> 1 row, 'timeout' -> 408+504, 'zzz' -> empty 'No data' state), and the badge-variant boundary mapping (2xx success / 3xx info / 4xx warning / 5xx danger).
